description: Simulates a Workday platform update that renames, adds, and changes fields

changes.description: Workday dropped the CF_ prefix convention and version suffixes in Q1 2025 field normalization
New mandatory compliance field added in Q1 2025 regulatory update
Start_Year changed from integer (e.g. 2019) to ISO date string (e.g. 2019-01-01) for date arithmetic consistency
